description: Filter incidents by status. Available values: open, resolved. Default: open
Filter incidents that started on or after this date. ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2025-06-01T00:00:00.000Z)
Filter incidents that ended on or before this date. ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2025-06-30T23:59:59.000Z)
Number of incidents to return per page (pagination). Default: 20
Page number of results to return. Default: 1
Number of incidents to skip (alternative to page-based pagination). Default: 0
Field to sort incidents by. Available values: start_time, end_time, severity, status. Default: end_time. For resolved incidents, end_time is recommended.

Incident end time. Null if still open.
